ruling: - **R16. A mistake is filed as a missing guard, by a hook.** Owner 16:22 CST Nov 10: "i thought i've already set something really high up in claude.md or elsewhere that sessions/agents should never assume an error is their own and instead should strongly be raised awareness that any error they make might be a strong INDICATOR that a guard/something-0mechanical should be in place?"; 16:25 CST: "yes agreed-- that or we create a hook taht looks for this kind of prose when the session says it so taht way the HOOK/judge files it not the session itself". Rule building-mistake-names-its-guard opens: "Read a mistake first as a missing guard or check, never as a fault to own: the way we work should make accidents hard." The report gives `Cause:` (what made it easy) and `Guard:` (built, queued or debt). A Stop hook spots a mistake told in a reply and its judge files the missing guard to triage, so the session does not file it itself. It runs inside the existing Stop hook; no new process. Cause that led here: the feedback-log hook writes a message heading without telling the session, so it wrote a second one twice (step inbox-dup-heading-merge). Home: CLAUDE.md building-mistake-names-its-guard; decision guard-remedy-not-to-owner.
